thread:
maria: Heads up — seeing a spike of 526/connection failures from hosted customers. Traced to the TLS header rewrite we shipped last night on the fast-path. Rolling an emergency shunt to a legacy route to stop customer impact.

ashwin: Confirmed — header rewrite is stripping client SNI in certain L7 proxies, downstream rejects TLS. Repro locally with curl + -v.

sam: Can we do a targeted shunt by host header so other traffic keeps fast-path?

maria: Yes. Plan: add a short-lived routing rule that matches on Host and X-Env and routes to legacy-static backend. TTL 15m, monitor, then remove.

jen: tagging oncall: I'll watch errors/latency. If errors > 2% for 5m, escalate to paging.

maria: deploy-bot: run toggle -> /ops/toggles/shunt-route --route=api.prod --match 'Host:customer-*.redwood.ai' --target legacy-static --expires 15m

deploy-bot: starting toggle: shunt-route-phi-1794122000 — creating policy, updating gateway config, dry-run checks...

deploy-bot: applied shunt (id: shunt-route-phi-1794122000). Changes propagated to edge nodes in ~12s. Rollout: 5% -> 50% -> 100% over 30s.

ashwin: quick verification:
```
# reproduce check
curl -H 'Host: customer-123.redwood.ai' -H 'X-Env: prod' -v https://api.redwood.ai/health
```
Expect: 200 from legacy-static; previously 526 from fast-path.

sam: watching metrics — error rate dropped from 4.7% -> 0.9% within 40s. Nice.

jen: monitoring dashboards: latency a tiny bit higher for shunted traffic but within SLO. Alert thresholds unchanged.

maria: action items while shunt is live:
- ashwin: revert header rewrite in fast-path branch + add unit/integration tests for SNI preservation
- ashwin: open PR and link to this thread
- sam: keep the shunt TTL for 15m, but be ready to extend to 1h if PR needs more time
- jen: keep paging window at 5m for error >2%

ashwin: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/fast-path/pull/842 — revert rewrite, add test. Requesting canary deploy after merge.

maria: if we need to rollback the shunt itself (failed shunt), procedure:
1) disable toggle via /ops/toggles/disable shunt-route-phi-1794122000
2) run gateway rollback: /ops/gateway/rollback --to-before shunt-route-phi-1794122000
3) if rollback partial, run node flush: /ops/edge/flush --selector shunt-route-phi-1794122000
4) escalate to eng-runtime and eng-sre

sam: noted. Also prepped an emergency script:
```
# emergency rollback helper (ops only)
/opt/tools/route-flip --id shunt-route-phi-1794122000 --mode emergency
```

deploy-bot: alert: shunt TTL expires in 12m. Auto-reminder at 2m remaining.

jen: observed no customer-facing errors for 10m. Keeping watch. :thumbsup:

maria: once ashwin's PR merges, we'll canary the fast-path fix (10% -> 50% -> 100%) behind a feature flag and then remove the shunt. Steps in order: merge PR -> deploy canary -> validate metrics for 15m -> flip feature flag -> remove shunt toggle.

ashwin: will queue the canary immediately after PR merge; pinging eng-release to prioritize.

ops-rotation: leaving a note for follow-up: add a synthetic test in the routing CI that exercises SNI + header rewrite combos. Ticket: OPS-1223.

maria: thanks team. I'll mark incident as mitigated once shunt removed and PR is live. Will post a short postmortem with timeline and corrective actions. :white_check_mark:
